content.short: Creatious gives creators link-in-bio profiles and Cardano Stickers for fan support and rewards online.
content.description: Creatious is a Cardano creator platform built around link-in-bio profiles and collectible Cardano Stickers. Creators can publish an original sticker image that fans collect as a web3 support mechanism, similar to a tip jar with NFT-like ownership features. Stickers can be minted repeatedly until the creator pauses or changes them, reducing the pressure of artificial scarcity while still giving fans a collectible way to show support. Creatious helps artists, builders, and online creators fund work and build a community of real fans.
content.meta: Creatious helps creators sell Cardano Stickers through link-in-bio profiles and fan rewards. Explore Creatious on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
